stc:

vi:
My journey with Idea Cellular began with large-scale BSS transformations and products serving more than 230 million subscribers across India.

Then came Vodafone and Idea's historic merger, creating Vi and one of the most complex telecom transformations I have experienced.

I worked across BSS transformation and product launches before becoming part of the massive Vodafone-Idea integration that ultimately created Vi.

Later, I contributed to the Vodafone-Idea merger, helping design campaigns and systems for a combined base of roughly 410 million subscribers across 23 regions.

Some products are built. Others are rebuilt while running.

India was my laboratory for learning product leadership at extraordinary scale.
